source: Manual Codex critical judgement using Protara 2025 Form 10-K, May 2026 corporate presentation, current ClinicalTrials.gov records, FDA labels, company clinical releases, and cited peer publications; as of 2026-07-11

market_share_notes.IV-Choline-Chloride: INCLUDE PS: the 30% base peak reflects first-mover status, no approved IV choline product globally, an estimated 30,000 long-term home-PS population and 78% reported choline deficiency, offset by a biomarker primary endpoint, uncertain payer conversion and compounding/workflow friction; 12% bear and 45% bull bracket slow versus broad guideline-led adoption.
market_share_notes.TARA-002-LM: INCLUDE LM: the 25% base peak recognizes the potential first FDA-approved localized therapy and 10/10 clinical success among eight-week evaluable STARBORN-1 patients at the April 10, 2026 cutoff, but discounts the 16-patient dataset, non-randomized design, variable lesion biology and strong low-cost off-label sclerotherapy outcomes; 10% bear and 40% bull reflect these adoption bounds.
market_share_notes.TARA-002-NMIBC: INCLUDE NMIBC-BU: 68.2% six-month landmark CR and clean tolerability support a differentiated BCG-free option, but Inlexzo's 82% any-time CR and several approved/late-stage bladder-sparing competitors cap the base peak at 9%. INCLUDE NMIBC-BN: 55.0% twelve-month landmark CR and no grade 3+ treatment-related events support inclusion, while BCG, intravesical chemotherapy and sasanlimab plus BCG constrain the base peak to 7%. EXCLUDE NMIBC-PAP: papillary-only expansion remains preclinical/exploratory with no active registrational efficacy dataset. EXCLUDE NMIBC-SYS: systemic priming or subcutaneous administration remains exploratory and has no independently financeable clinical program or approval path.
